title: Modes file: the option chosen for each trip of one day
description: Written by the LLM (llm_stub.py modes stands in until then) from the choices file (make_choices.py), and read with the schedule by convert_demand.py. That also checks what a schema cannot: every trip of the schedule has exactly one choice, every trip_id is in the schedule, route_id is a jeepney line, and every chosen trip can be made (a car or bike only where it was left). See README.md.

day.description: The same day as the schedule.

made_by.description: Who or what wrote the file (model, prompt version).

trip_id.description: A trip from the choices file, e.g. A0001_D01_T01.

route_id.description: The jeepney line: needed with mode jeepney, and only then.

reasoning.description: Why, in a sentence. Optional, kept for reading.
